method.t: Freshness windows: YouTube public data fresh for 7 days, stale after 30 (YouTube API data must be refreshed or deleted within 30 days); Stripe fresh for 7 days, stale after 30 (Stripe is read live, so a week-old read is already behind); Substack export fresh for 30 days, stale after 90 (Substack data arrives as a manual export); Podcast RSS feed fresh for 7 days, stale after 30 (Feeds change with every episode).

Tolerances, freshness windows and risk thresholds are Orbe's provisional judgements, published so a reader can disagree with them, and will be replaced by measured distributions as verified records accumulate.
Revenue is gross, in GBP, by the month it belongs to. The trailing twelve months run Oct 2025 to Sep 2026; the current month is left out until complete.
